messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: High push-path CPU and SSE connection churn in us-west-2. Error rate increasing ~8% on push frames. Paging on-call @mira. Runbook: PUSH_SURGE_v2.
mira (oncall): Ack, investigating. Assigning to @jonas and @katie. What customers impacted?
jonas (runtime): Seeing sustained 300k active SSEs; per-host CPU at 92%. KV cache thrash on prefix cache. Majority are streaming responses >512 tokens. Logs: `push-send-timeouts` spikes.
katie (eng-sre): Plan: soft-disable streaming responses for non-enterprise routes, flip feature-flag to polling fallback, and apply short rate-limit on /v1/stream endpoints. Will coordinate with support for comms.
mira (oncall): Commands?
jonas (runtime): Run: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/services/flags/flip -d '{ "flag": "enable_streaming", "value": false, "scope": "default" }' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'``` Rolling to 50% then 100% in 2m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag change queued by jonas, canarying on 2 hosts.
katie (eng-sre): Also applying temporary egress rate-limit: `rate-limit: 60 req/min per IP` on /v1/stream for next 30m. Support: increase client retry backoff guidance.
support-lead: Notifying top-10 customers and CS leads. Draft message: 'We are temporarily switching streaming to polling to stabilize latency; no data loss expected; will update in 30m.'
mira (oncall): Handing off to katie for mitigation. I'm stepping out of pager for 15m — ping if SLA hits. monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/INC-3623456789
katie (eng-sre): Flag flipped to 50% -> observing CPU drop to 70% and SSE drop ~60k within 90s. Increasing to 100% now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: flag rollout to 100% successful.
jonas (runtime): Traffic normalized. Latency P95 down from 340ms to 120ms. Keeping polling fallback for 20m then re-evaluate.
mira (oncall): Thanks. Leaving incident open with 'mitigated' state. We'll reconvene if error rate >1%.
